_why: F6 section 3 (2026-10-09): the sentences the report prints about its questions, read by test_question_lines.py and derive.test.ts alike so the PDF and the web print the same words for the same input. 'setLines': the line for the scan's question set ('questionSet' is the report's field, null for a scan before this change; its 'sourceScanDate' is a day, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, never a time). 'pastYear': whether one question's text names a calendar year earlier than the scan's own year (years 1990 to scanYear - 1, written in ASCII digits; a range counts by its last year, so 2025-26 in 2026 is not past, and a tail that is not after the start, as in 2025-12, is a month and not a range end). 'pastYearLines': the one line saying how many questions name a past year; 'promptsTab' is true only on the signed-in web report, where the pointer to the client's Prompts tab is something the reader can follow. 'shelfCases': the distinct flagged questions out of the report's prompt shelf, in question order.
